headline: Chinese companies have proposed implementing irrigation projects in Uzbekistan at more than twice the estimated cost
summary: Uzbekistan's water minister said irrigation projects funded by Chinese money are delayed. Contractors proposed prices more than double the estimate and 20% above tender levels, and talks lasting over a year have not succeeded.
why: Large infrastructure projects funded by foreign lenders and contractors affect project costs, timelines and public finances. Investors watch such disputes as indicators of execution risk in emerging-market infrastructure.
original_headline: Xitoy kompaniyalari O‘zbekistondagi irrigatsiya loyihalarini hisob-kitobdan ikki baravardan ortiq qimmatga amalga oshirishni taklif qilgan
